Degrees and Programs

Undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral degrees.

Undergraduate Programs (BA)

Bachelor of Arts in Ministry Leadership

America Evangelical University offers a Bachelor’s degree in Ministry Leadership based on 120 semester units. The program may be completed in four academic years of full-time study.

View Program

Bachelor of Arts in Computer Science

AEU's BACS is designed to equip students for information technology careers. The computer science major emphasizes hands-on industry application and knowledge.

View Program

Master's Programs

MA in Organizational and Global Leadership

M.A. in Organizational Leadership (Global Leadership) is a program which can enable students to gain advanced knowledge of core ministerial, missional, and business leadership practices, especially coaching, from diverse approaches.

View Program

Master of Divinity

The Master of Divinity (MDiv) program is designed to equip students with skills to integrate biblical and theological reflection with hands-on ministry experience to become servant leaders in local church settings, in parachurch organizations, as well as in the mission field.

View Program

Master of Arts in Counseling (M.A.C.)

The Master of Arts in Counseling (M.A.C.) is a 40-unit graduate program integrating counseling theory, clinical practice, and Christian faith, with two specialized tracks: Marriage & Family Therapy (MFT) and Substance Use Disorder (SUD) Counseling.

View Program

Master of Arts in Counseling Psychology (M.A.C.P.)

The Master of Arts in Counseling Psychology (M.A.C.P.) is a 66-unit graduate program preparing students for California licensure as LMFT or LPCC, integrating psychological science, clinical skills, and Christian faith.

View Program

Master of Arts in Ministry Leadership

The Master of Arts in Ministry Leadership (MAML) is designed for persons preparing for Christian ministry, with a particular view towards persons who wish to minister in cross-cultural or multicultural environments. The program is suitable for persons seeking academic preparation for service as missionaries, cross-cultural workers, pastors, teachers, and researchers.

View Program

Doctoral Programs

Doctor of Ministry

AEU’s D.Min. is designed to equip ordained pastors and missionaries with a dynamic and effective pastoral/missional leadership in the contemporary postmodern world.

View Program

Doctor of Counseling

The Doctor of Counseling is designed to build the knowledge and skills of counselors who work in churches or faith-based organizations, equipping them with the tools necessary to bring healing and hope to hurting individuals.

View Program

Ph.D. in Organizational and Global Leadership

The Ph.D. in Organizational and Global Leadership is a degree program offering two tracks of concentrations that will equip students to serve as missional leaders throughout diverse global ministry contexts.

View Program

Associate & Certificate Programs (AA)

Associate of Arts in Ministry Leadership

The AA in Ministry Leadership program is designed to equip students for pastoral ministry and leadership within the local church setting, at a non-profit organization, or in a mission organization. This program is a distinct and short-term program in biblical and leadership studies for students who may not be able to commit to a more extensive program.

View Program

Associate of Arts in Computer Science

The AACS degree curriculum will develop students' core competencies for success in IT careers and leadership in that field. The program emphasizes hands-on industry application and knowledge. <br>*The AACS program is only offered in English.

View Program
